mentions.name: Wake.lol
mentions.description: A web-based tool for quickly enabling wake lock (keeping the device screen awake) on any platform, with no installation required and offline capability.
mentions.problem: Enabling wake lock on a device is not quick or easy across platforms; this makes it a one-step, no-install, offline-capable action.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I want to make it easier to just quickly enable wake lock on your device in a cross platform, no install, offline capable way. It's a silly little project but I'm super proud of it.

https://wake.lol/
